steps.content: The fierce battle has severely damaged the ground, scattering shattered rocks and debris.
In the heart of the ruins, a dark figure is muttering alone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait... that purple outfit... and the Legion's emblem...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's a projection of the Legion Commander Zoya.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No way, that looks nothing like her! That silly portrait and design could be of anyone but her!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is just a simulation of the Sinner created by Project: Dark. While the projections may act out of character or behave strangely, they still retain the original Sinner’s power.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Well... go on, Hella. I’ve got your back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...For real? You want me to deal with Zoya?
With Hecate's encouragement, Hella inches closer to Zoya, who sits slumped on the ground. Hella reaches out, hoping to touch Zoya and break whatever that's binding her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa, Zoya, please calm down! We're just trying to help you!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You want my spot? Hah, you'll have to beat me first!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I thought you are the Legion?! This is definitely not Zoya!
